bosses.name: Mirrax
bosses.levelUpDesc: Choose another Boss. For the rest of the game, this boss also has that Boss's treasure icon. (The icon remains even if that boss dies.)

bosses.name: Doc Scarecrow
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, during the Build phase you may discard one card to choose one Hero in town. That Hero cannot be lured this turn.

bosses.name: Belladonna
bosses.levelUpDesc: Heal a Wound. (Turn one face-down Hero face-up.)

bosses.name: Torix Uz'Kali
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, whenever any Monster Room is discarded or destroyed, you may put it into your hand.

bosses.name: Killa
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, if you have 3 Wounds or more, give the last Room of your dungeon +3

bosses.name: Shellda
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, at end of turn you may swap the placement of two Rooms in one dungeon.

bosses.name: Smoake
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, whenever you build a Monster Room, you may Draw a Room card.

bosses.name: Kazanna
bosses.levelUpDesc: Discard your hand, then draw 3 Spell cards.

bosses.name: Dr. Timebender
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, once per turn you may discard a Spell card to cancel an opponent's Spell.

bosses.name: Nicolius
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, you may draw a Spell card at the end of turn if any player has gained two more souls than you that turn.

bosses.name: Porkus
bosses.levelUpDesc: Choose one face-down Hero from your scorekeeping area and remove it from the game. Search the Hero decks, choose one Hero, and place it face-down in your scorekeeping area.

bosses.name: Angstigoth
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, once per turn when you kill a Hero, draw a Room card.

bosses.name: Eclipse
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, when you destroy a Room in your dungeon, the uncovered Room gains +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Imp Temple
rooms.description: Once per turn, when you force an opponent to discard a card, put that card into your hand instead.

rooms.name: Haunted Hall
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to send a Hero in this Room back to town.

rooms.name: Inner Sanctum
rooms.description: At the end of each turn, if no Heroes entered this Room, you may draw a Room card.

rooms.name: Incubus Gym
rooms.description: When you build this Room, each opponent must discard a Room card.

rooms.name: Dragon Graveyard
rooms.description: Once per turn, if you take a card from the discard pile, draw a Room card.

rooms.name: Rust Monster Pen
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Monster Room to give one Trap Room -1 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Goblin Nursery
rooms.description: If the Room to the left of this is a Monster Room, give that Room +2

rooms.name: Spawn Point
rooms.description: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, draw two Room cards.

rooms.name: Fangroot Garden
rooms.description: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, you may immediately build another Room in your dunegon.

rooms.name: Shrooman Cave
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, give another Monster Room +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Goblin Mess Hall
rooms.description: Give ever other Monster Room in your dungeon +1

rooms.name: Megaworm Burrow
rooms.description: When you build this Room, choose and destroy one Advanced Room in any dungeon.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may reveal a Monster Room from your hand to give this Room +X, where X is that Room's power.

rooms.name: Frostbat Cave
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to deactivate one Room in any dungeon.

rooms.name: Bullet Builder
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Trap Room to give one Monster Room -1 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Wreck Room
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may destroy another Room in your dungeon to draw a Room card.

rooms.name: Deadly Treadmill
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Room card to draw a Room card.

rooms.name: Collapsing Bridge
rooms.description:
If a Hero survives this Room, until the end of turn this Room deals +3

Revised: Once per turn, if a Hero survives this Room, until end of turn this Room deals +3.

rooms.name: Spiked Pit
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, give this Room +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Decapitator
rooms.description: During the Build phase, you may destroy this Room to choose one Room in any dungeon and remove its treasure value until end of turn.

rooms.name: Chump Chomper
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may destroy another Room in your dungeon to give this Room +4 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Blockpile Puzzle
rooms.description: At the end of each turn, destroy one Room in your dungeon.

rooms.name: The Smashinator
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may destroy every other visible Room in your dungeon to give this Room +6 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Warp Tube
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to send a Hero in this Room back to the first Room of your dungeon.

rooms.name: Bom-Boy Factory
rooms.description: When a Hero dies in this Room or survives this Room, destroy this Room.

rooms.name: Hatchling's Hoard
rooms.description: (You may build this over a room with Cleric, Fighter, Mage, or Thief treasure.)

rooms.name: Werewolf Den
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a card from your hand to give one Hero +1 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Cursed Tomb
rooms.description: If an effect from another card causes this Room to be destroyed, each opponent must discard two Room cards.

rooms.name: Vampire
rooms.description: Once per turn, any opponent may discard a Room with Cleric to give this Hero +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Barbarian
rooms.description: Once per turn, any opponent may discard a Room with Fighter to give this Hero +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Witch
rooms.description: Once per turn, any opponent may discard a Room with Mage to give this Hero +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Hitman
rooms.description: Once per turn, any opponent may discard a Room with Thief to give this Hero +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Dragon's Hoard
rooms.description: When you build this Room, draw a Room card.

rooms.name: Shadow Corridor
rooms.description: Ordinary Trap Rooms in your dungeon have +1 damage.

rooms.name: Crypt of Souls
rooms.description: When a Hero dies in this Room, draw a Spell card.

rooms.name: Archer
rooms.description:
This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Fighter and Thief treasure. This Hero ignores the last Room of your dungeon.

Revised: This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Fighter and Thief treasure. This Hero skips the last Room of your dungeon.

spells.name: Dark Portal
spells.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Spell card to choose one Room card from the discard pile and put it into your hand.

spells.name: Madman's Manor
spells.description: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, choose one Spell card from the discard pile and put it into your hand.

spells.name: Arcane Crypt
spells.description: When you build or uncover this Room, you may choose one Spell card from the discard pile and put it into your hand.

spells.name: Wraith's Throne
spells.description: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, each opponent must discard a Spell card.

spells.name: Barbarian Hall
spells.description: When you build this Room, choose and discard one Spell card (if you have any Spell cards in your hand).

spells.name: Antimagic Zone
spells.description: You may discard this from your hand to cancel an opponent's Spell. (The Spell is not cast. Place it in the discard pile.)

spells.name: Lost Library
spells.description: You may destroy this Room to draw two Spell cards, then discard a Spell card.

spells.name: Spellslime Pit
spells.description: Whenever you play a Spell, this Room gains +1 until end of turn.

spells.name: Observatory
spells.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Spell card to draw a Spell card.

spells.name: Sorcerobe School
spells.description: When you build or uncover this Room, draw a Spell card.

spells.name: Hall of Mirrors
spells.description: Once per turn when an opponent plays a Spell card, draw a Spell card.

spells.name: Elemental Generator
spells.description: This Room has +X, where X equals the number of Spell cards in your hand.

spells.name: Brainsucker Queen
spells.description: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, draw two Spell cards, then discard a Spell card.

spells.name: Genie Lounge
spells.description: When you build this Room, if you have no Spell cards in your hand, draw a Spell card.

spells.name: Save Point
spells.description: You may destroy this Room to retrieve one Spell card from the discard pile that you played this turn.

spells.name: All Your Base
spells.description: View an opponent's hand. You may take one Room card from that opponent.

spells.name: Another Castle
spells.description: Choose a Hero in your dungeon. Send that Hero to the entrance of an opponent's dungeon.

spells.name: Fairy Fountain
spells.description: Choose a Room. Until end of turn, it does zero damage and each Hero entering it gains +1.

spells.name: It's On!
spells.description: Kill one Hero in your dungeon who has 3 or less Health. OR If you have 3 wounds or more, kill one Hero in your dungeon.

spells.name: Hiring Spree
spells.description: Draw three Room cards, then give another player one of your Room cards.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt!
spells.description: Deal 3 damage to one Hero in your dungeon. AND If you discard another Spell card, deal 3 damage to each Hero at the entrance to your dungeon.

spells.name: Meddling Kids!
spells.description: Choose a Room. Until the end of turn, it has no ability text. OR Choose a player. If three or more Heroes entered that player's dungeon this turn, that player cannot win this turn.

spells.name: Oh, Yeah!
spells.description: Swap the placement of two Rooms in your dungeon. OR If two or more of your Rooms have been destroyed this turn, choose and destroy one Room in any dungeon.

spells.name: Party Up
spells.description: Choose a dungeon. Until the end of turn, each Hero entering that dungeon gains +1

spells.name: Pause
spells.description: If there is a Hero in your dungeon, return it to the entrance and restore it to full Health. No Heroes may enter your dungeon until next turn.

spells.name: Pity
spells.description: Choose a Hero in an opponent's dungeon. Remove that Hero from the game.

spells.name: Secret Stash
spells.description: Choose a Room in your dungeon. Until end of turn, give it one extra Cleric, Fighter, Mage or Thief.

spells.name: Shortcut!
spells.description: Choose a Hero in any dungeon. It skips the next Room it would enter. OR If that dungeon has five Rooms, the Hero skips the next two Rooms it would enter.

spells.name: Super Effective!
spells.description: Choose a Room in your dungeon. It deals +2 until end of turn. OR If only one Hero was lured to your dungeon this turn, that Room does +4 until end of turn.

spells.name: Surprise Gift
spells.description: During the Build phase, you may place a Room in an opponent's dungeon instead of your own. (Place it face-down over a face-up Room. Opponent may still place another Room. Any build effects apply to the opponent.)

spells.name: Undead Minion
spells.description: Choose one face-down Hero in your scorekeeping area and remove it from the game. Deal damage equal to that Hero's Health to one Hero in your dungeon.

spells.name: Wild Monster
spells.description: You may immediately build a Monster Room over an existing Room in your dungeon.

spells.name: Mage
spells.description: A Kid and His Spellslime|A Kid and His Spellslime] When an ordinary kid discovered a wounded spellslime, he nursed it back to health with candy. The spellslime rewarded his kindness with an adventure to a world of magic.

spells.name: Necromancer
spells.description: This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Mage and Fighter treasure. Each time a player plays a Spell while this Hero is in your dungeon, give this Hero +2.

spells.name: Swordmage
spells.description: This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Mage and Fighter treasure. Each time a player plays a Spell while this Hero is in your dungeon, give this Hero +2

spells.name: Druid
spells.description: This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Cleric and Mage treasure. Give this Hero +X, where X equals the number of Spell cards in your hand.

spells.name: Dark Pact
spells.description: Draw 2 Spell cards.

spells.name: Dungeon Shift
spells.description: Rearrange the Rooms in your dungeon.
